_meta.purpose: Starter database of INS-numbered additives commonly found on Indian packaged food, with functional class, concern level, and citable basis. This is the SCORING layer (distinct from NOVA definitional markers).

concern_scale.none: Permitted, no notable safety signal. 0 penalty.
concern_scale.low: Permitted; minor or context-dependent concerns. Small penalty.
concern_scale.moderate: Permitted in India but carries real concerns (evidence such as ADI limits, sensitivity reactions, or a regulator's published safety opinion). Medium penalty.
concern_scale.high: Not permitted in India, OR a strong health signal. Large penalty. Another country's legal status never sets concern: that is information-only context in regulatory_status.json (D-086).

_meta.CRITICAL_VERIFY_NOTICE: Every 'fssai_status' and 'banned_*' field below MUST be verified against current FSSAI (FSS Food Additives Regulations & amendments) before ANY public 'banned/permitted' claim. Fields are marked with 'confidence' and 'verify: true' where they carry legal exposure. Do not ship 'banned in India' claims on 'verify: true' rows without checking live FSSAI notifications.

scoring.rule: A 'low' additive takes the low penalty only if it carries one of low_penalty_flags. A 'low' additive whose flags only name its class (emulsifier, preservative, modified_starch, ...) scores 0: long lists of ordinary baking additives should not sink a score on their own. NOVA markers are scored separately and are unaffected; the flag still appears in the verdict, and the claim checker still reads the class. Decided 2026-09-25.

_meta.verification_log: Rows with verified_on were checked on that date: name against Codex CAC/GL 36-1989 (INS list); permission against the FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011 compendium Version XXVI (20.12.2022) - fssai_basis says whether it is in the GMP table for all food categories or has numeric limits; and the First Amendment Regulations 2025 (gazette 14.07.2025, in force 01.02.2026), which changes none of them. Concern levels are a scoring judgement, not a regulatory fact.

sources_key.FSSAI: FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, India
sources_key.EFSA: European Food Safety Authority scientific opinion
sources_key.SOUTHAMPTON: McCann et al., Lancet 2007 - colours linked to hyperactivity in children (the 'Southampton Six')
sources_key.WHO: WHO / JECFA position or IARC classification
sources_key.CODEX: Codex CAC/GL 36-1989, Class Names and the International Numbering System for Food Additives (names and functional classes)
sources_key.NOVA: Monteiro et al., NOVA classification (see nova_markers.json)

sources_shown._note: 2026-10-04: the words a result card shows for each sources code (the codes are table keys, never shown to users).

additives.name: Tartrazine
additives.why: Synthetic azo dye. Linked to hyperactivity in sensitive children (Southampton study).
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Sunset Yellow FCF
additives.why: Synthetic azo dye. Linked to hyperactivity in sensitive children (Southampton study).
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Carmoisine / Azorubine
additives.why: Synthetic azo dye. Linked to hyperactivity in sensitive children (Southampton study).
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Ponceau 4R
additives.why: Synthetic azo dye. Linked to hyperactivity in sensitive children (Southampton study).
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Allura Red AC
additives.why: Synthetic azo dye. Linked to hyperactivity in sensitive children (Southampton study).
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Brilliant Blue FCF
additives.why: Synthetic colour. Generally permitted; some avoid synthetic dyes.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Sulphite ammonia caramel
additives.why: Caramel colour class IV. Contains 4-MEI (IARC 2B) at high exposure. Common in colas.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Titanium dioxide
additives.why: White colour. Permitted in India. EFSA's 2021 safety opinion could not rule out a genotoxicity concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table); also double fortified salt

additives.name: Sorbic acid
additives.why: Preservative. Generally regarded as low-concern.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category, as SORBATES (Appendix A, Annexure-1)

additives.name: Potassium sorbate
additives.why: Common preservative. Low concern; invalidates 'no preservatives' claims.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category, as SORBATES (Appendix A, Annexure-1)

additives.name: Sodium benzoate
additives.why: Preservative. With ascorbic acid (C) can form benzene. Southampton study pairing.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category, as BENZOATES (Appendix A, Annexure-1)

additives.name: Sodium metabisulphite
additives.why: Sulphite preservative. Can trigger asthma/allergic reactions; mandatory allergen-style declaration in many regions.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category, as SULFITES (Appendix A, Annexure-1)

additives.name: Sodium nitrite
additives.why: Curing agent in processed meats. Nitrosamine formation; processed meat is IARC Group 1 (carcinogenic to humans).
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits, meat products only, as NITRITES (Appendix A Table 8, Annexure-1)

additives.name: Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C)
additives.why: Vitamin C used as antioxidant. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Malic acid
additives.why: The acid in apples; used as an acidity regulator and for a sour taste. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table, as Malic acid, DL-)

additives.name: Tertiary butylhydroquinone (TBHQ)
additives.why: Synthetic antioxidant that slows oils going rancid, common in fried snacks and biscuits. Appendix A sets a maximum per food category (200 mg/kg in fats and oils).
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A); in some categories singly or in combination with BHA and BHT (note 195)

additives.name: Lecithin
additives.why: Common emulsifier (often soy). NOVA cosmetic-additive marker but low safety concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Citric acid
additives.why: Ubiquitous acidity regulator. No safety concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Sodium phosphates
additives.why: Phosphate additive. High dietary phosphate additives flagged for kidney/cardiovascular load.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category, as PHOSPHATES (Appendix A, Annexure-1)

additives.name: Carrageenan
additives.why: Seaweed thickener. EFSA (2018) found no adverse effects in long-term studies and set a temporary daily limit until better data came in. NOVA cosmetic marker.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Guar gum
additives.why: Thickener. Low concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Xanthan gum
additives.why: Thickener. Low concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Monosodium glutamate (MSG)
additives.why: Flavour enhancer. Permitted; some report sensitivity. Signals ultra-processed formulation. Not permitted in foods for infants.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Disodium guanylate
additives.why: Flavour enhancer, usually paired with MSG. Signals ultra-processed formulation.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Disodium inosinate
additives.why: Flavour enhancer, paired with MSG. Signals ultra-processed formulation.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Disodium 5'-ribonucleotides
additives.why: Flavour enhancer blend. Signals ultra-processed formulation.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC)
additives.why: Cellulose thickener. NOVA cosmetic marker; low safety concern but recent emulsifier-gut research ongoing.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
additives.why: Very common emulsifier. NOVA cosmetic marker. May contain trans fats depending on source.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Diacetyltartaric and fatty acid esters of glycerol (DATEM)
additives.why: Emulsifier and dough strengthener in bread and biscuits. NOVA cosmetic marker.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Polyglycerol polyricinoleate (PGPR)
additives.why: Emulsifier common in chocolate. NOVA cosmetic marker.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits, cocoa and chocolate products (Appendix A Table 5)

additives.name: Sodium bicarbonate
additives.why: Baking soda. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Silicon dioxide
additives.why: Anti-caking agent. Generally low concern; nanoparticle form under review.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: (reserved)
additives.why: placeholder to keep list extensible

additives.name: Acesulfame potassium (Ace-K)
additives.why: Artificial sweetener. NOVA cosmetic marker. Relevant for diabetic and children lenses.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Aspartame
additives.why: Artificial sweetener. IARC classified 'possibly carcinogenic' (2B) in 2023; JECFA retained ADI. Not for PKU. NOVA marker.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Cyclamate
additives.why: Artificial sweetener. Not permitted as a food additive in India.
additives.fssai_basis: listed only in the regulation's INS reference list; no Appendix A provision

additives.name: Saccharin
additives.why: Artificial sweetener. Historical carcinogen concern (delisted). NOVA marker.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category, as SACCHARINS (Appendix A, Annexure-1)

additives.name: Sucralose
additives.why: Artificial sweetener. NOVA marker. WHO 2023 advises against non-sugar sweeteners for weight control. Key for diabetic lens.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Steviol glycosides (Stevia)
additives.why: Plant-derived sweetener. WHO 2023 advises against non-sugar sweeteners, stevia among them, for weight control. NOVA cosmetic marker.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Caramel III - ammonia caramel
additives.why: Caramel colour class III. Like class IV, can contain 4-MEI (IARC 2B) as a by-product.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Carotenes (beta-carotene)
additives.why: Beta-carotene colour, the pigment in carrots; provitamin A.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Calcium carbonate
additives.why: Chalk / calcium source; also used as a colour and raising agent. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Lactic acid
additives.why: Acidity regulator, the same acid made in curd. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Calcium propionate
additives.why: Preservative common in bread and bakery. Low concern; its presence contradicts a 'no preservatives' claim.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Sodium citrates
additives.why: Sodium salts of citric acid. Acidity regulator. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Phosphoric acid
additives.why: Acidulant typical of colas. Phosphate additive; high intake from additives is flagged for kidney and bone load.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Calcium phosphates
additives.why: Raising agent / anticaking agent. Phosphate additive.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Sodium alginate
additives.why: Seaweed-derived thickener. Low concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Gum arabic (Acacia gum)
additives.why: Tree-gum stabiliser. Low concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Sorbitol
additives.why: Sugar alcohol used to keep products moist, or as a sweetener. Can have a laxative effect in large amounts.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Glycerol
additives.why: Humectant that keeps baked goods soft. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Pectins
additives.why: Fruit-derived gelling agent. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Diphosphates
additives.why: Raising agent in baking powder. Phosphate additive.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Polyglycerol esters of fatty acids
additives.why: Emulsifier used in cakes and bakery. NOVA cosmetic marker.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Sodium stearoyl lactylate
additives.why: Dough strengthener and emulsifier in bread and bakery. NOVA cosmetic marker.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Ammonium carbonates
additives.why: Traditional raising agent (baker's ammonia); gas escapes during baking. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Calcium sulfate
additives.why: Firming agent and flour treatment; used to set tofu. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Amylases
additives.why: Enzyme that breaks down starch; used in flour and baking. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Proteases
additives.why: Protein-splitting enzymes (e.g. papain, bromelain); used in flour and baking. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Lipases
additives.why: Fat-splitting enzyme; used in baking and dairy. No concern.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Distarch phosphate
additives.why: Chemically modified starch (thickener). NOVA ultra-processing marker.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Acetylated distarch adipate
additives.why: Chemically modified starch (thickener). NOVA ultra-processing marker.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Hydroxypropyl starch
additives.why: Chemically modified starch (thickener). NOVA ultra-processing marker.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Hydroxypropyl distarch phosphate
additives.why: Chemically modified starch (thickener). NOVA ultra-processing marker.
additives.fssai_basis: GMP, all food categories (Appendix A GMP table)

additives.name: Propylene glycol
additives.why: Humectant and carrier for flavours. Has an acceptable daily intake; low concern at permitted levels.

additives.name: Erythrosine
additives.why: Synthetic red colour. Caused thyroid tumours in male rats at high doses.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Fast Green FCF
additives.why: Synthetic green colour.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits per food category (Appendix A)

additives.name: Benzoyl peroxide
additives.why: Flour bleaching agent; breaks down to benzoic acid in the flour. Rarely printed on labels because it treats the flour before use.
additives.fssai_basis: numeric limits (flours and starches; whey) (Appendix A)

additives.name: Azodicarbonamide
additives.why: Flour treatment agent. Not permitted as a food additive in India.
additives.fssai_basis: listed only in the regulation's INS reference list; no Appendix A provision
